dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible symmetrical 2D narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior, terminating in a sharpened point.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median grey intensity indicative of a juvenile or sub-adult phase; significantly darker than mature white but lighter than newborn slate grey.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High density of irregular, low-contrast dark and light grey patches distributed globally across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients between different pigmented regions, creating a soft textural appearance.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single high-contrast dark circular spot located in the anterior dorsal region. Several faint, thin, longitudinal light-colored streaks are visible on the mid-posterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of subtle, longitudinal linear marks on the lower half of the dorsal surface.
